name: Jeweled Letter Opener
full_text: A jeweled letter opener sitting on one of the reading desks in M3. Mundane in function but ornately decorated; worth 20 gp as a sellable curio. Per the adventure's conclusion rules, items that are part of treasure, books, specimens, or weapons acquired in the mansion remain with the party after they leave; anything else evaporates passing through the portal.
summary: 20 gp jeweled letter opener on a reading desk in the library (M3).
